weather.skinTempDesc: Tropical body heat warms fragrance liquid droplets, accelerating the release of top note molecules (citrus & aldehyde) from the epidermis.
weather.evaporationDesc: Calculated based on the ratio of temperature ({temp}°C) and wind speed ({speed} km/h) influencing fragrance oil volatility.
weather.projectionDesc: Expected longevity of active scent projection on skin before settling into a skin scent.

weather.sprayAdviceHighHumidity: High humidity (>80% RH): Spray on collar or clothing fabric to prevent sweat from washing away aroma molecules.
weather.sprayAdviceDryAir: Relatively dry air: Moisturize skin with fragrance-free lotion before spraying for optimal projection.
weather.sprayAdviceDryAirPulse: Dry air. Use skin moisturizer or unscented lotion before spraying pulse points (wrists & neck).
weather.sprayAdviceExtremeHeat: Extreme heat: Limit to 3-4 sprays on pulse points (neck & wrists).
weather.sprayAdviceStandard: Standard application: 4-5 sprays on pulse points and clothing.
weather.sprayTipCollar: • Spray on collar or clothes if humidity > 80% RH
weather.sprayTipMoisturize: • Moisturize skin if air is dry (< 55% RH)

about.title: About ScentCast Malaysia
about.subtitle: Fragrance intelligence powered by real tropical weather
about.scienceDesc: High humidity and intense heat accelerate perfume molecule evaporation. ScentCast calculates molecular kinetics for each scent profile.
about.desc: Designed specifically to unravel why luxury fragrances fade fast and turn sour in Malaysia's 32°C heat and 80% RH humidity.
about.card1Desc: Our testing shows skin surface temperature in Malaysia reaches over 34.8°C midday, accelerating citrus volatility 3 times faster than in Europe.
about.card2Desc: Dense atmospheric water molecules trap heavy aromatic compounds, explaining why rich gourmand scents can trigger cloying heaviness in tropical heat.
about.card3Desc: We benchmark quality alternatives from the UAE and Malaysian artisan perfumers to ensure you experience luxury fragrance DNAs with optimal tropical performance.
